title: 声声慢（寻寻觅觅）
author: 李清照
intro: Widowed, homeless and alone in a war-torn south, Li Qingzhao spends an autumn day waiting for dark. It opens with fourteen doubled characters that sound like sighing, and ends: how could one word, “sorrow”, ever cover all this?
analysis: 这首词是李清照晚年写的。那时北宋已经灭亡，她逃到南方，丈夫赵明诚去世，收藏多年的书画文物也大多丢失，她一个人孤苦生活。开头连用七组叠字（重复的字）：“寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚”，好像在寻找什么，却什么也找不到，只剩下冷清和悲伤。这十四个字读起来像一声声叹息，是中国诗词里最有名的开头之一。接着写天气忽冷忽热，身体难以调养；喝几杯淡酒，也挡不住傍晚的冷风。大雁飞过，好像是以前的老相识——雁能传信，可现在已经没有人可以写信了。下阕写满地凋谢的菊花，没有人想去摘；她守着窗户，一个人怎么熬到天黑？黄昏时细雨打在梧桐叶上，一点一滴，好像滴在心上。最后说：这种情景，怎么能用一个“愁”字说得完！全词用的都是平常的词，却层层写出深深的孤独。
analysisEn: Li Qingzhao wrote this late in life. The Northern Song had fallen to invaders, she had fled south, her husband Zhao Mingcheng had died, and most of the books and art they had collected together were lost. She was living alone. The lyric opens with seven pairs of doubled characters — 寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚, “searching, searching; cold, cold, quiet, quiet; bleak, bleak, miserable, miserable, grieving, grieving”. She is looking for something and finding nothing, only chill and sorrow. Read aloud, the fourteen characters sound like sighs, and they are among the most famous openings in all Chinese poetry. The weather keeps switching between warm and cold; a few cups of weak wine can’t keep out the evening wind. Wild geese fly over — old acquaintances, she says, since geese were said to carry letters, but now there is no one left to write to. In the second half, faded chrysanthemums cover the ground and no one wants to pick them. She sits by the window: how can she possibly last alone until dark? At dusk a fine rain drips on the wutong leaves, drop by drop, as if onto her heart. Then the final line: how could one word, “sorrow”, ever be enough for all of this? Everything is said in ordinary words, layer upon layer.
background: Li Qingzhao (1084–c.1155) fled south after the Jurchen Jin conquered the north in 1127; her husband died in 1129. This lyric is traditionally dated to her later years in the south, though its exact date is unknown.
pronunciation: 乍暖还寒：还 读 huán（统编教材注音；也有人读 hái）。将息 jiāng xī（调养身体）。怎生得黑：得 dé（熬到）。窗儿：儿化，读 chuāngr，网站逐字注 er。有谁堪摘：谁 本网站注 shuí（诗词朗读常用读法，口语 shéi）。了得 liǎo dé。更兼 gèng jiān。次第 cì dì。戚戚 qī qī。
version: 采用统编高中语文教材（必修上册）版本。重要异文：“怎敌他、晚来风急”一作“怎敌他晓来风急”；“梧桐更兼细雨”无重要异文；标点各本略有不同（如“怎敌他晚来风急”不加顿号）。全词上下两阕，网站按句读分为八行。

lines.zh: 寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚。
lines.rhythm: 寻寻/觅觅，冷冷/清清，凄凄/惨惨/戚戚
lines.py: xún xún mì mì, lěng lěng qīng qīng, qī qī cǎn cǎn qī qī
lines.lit: Searching, seeking; cold, cold, quiet, quiet; bleak, bleak, miserable, miserable, grieving, grieving.
lines.en: Searching, searching — cold and empty, empty and cold — bleak, wretched, full of grief.

lines.zh: 乍暖还寒时候，最难将息。
lines.rhythm: 乍暖/还寒/时候，最难/将息
lines.py: zhà nuǎn huán hán shí hòu, zuì nán jiāng xī
lines.lit: Times when it is suddenly warm and then cold again — hardest to rest and recover.
lines.en: In this weather, warm one moment and cold again the next, it is hardest to take care of myself.
lines.tts: 乍暖环寒时候，最难将息。

lines.zh: 三杯两盏淡酒，怎敌他、晚来风急！
lines.rhythm: 三杯/两盏/淡酒，怎敌他/晚来/风急
lines.py: sān bēi liǎng zhǎn dàn jiǔ, zěn dí tā, wǎn lái fēng jí
lines.lit: Three cups, two bowls of weak wine — how can they withstand the evening’s sharp wind!
lines.en: A few cups of thin wine — how could they hold off the hard wind coming at nightfall?

lines.zh: 雁过也，正伤心，却是旧时相识。
lines.rhythm: 雁/过也，正/伤心，却是/旧时/相识
lines.py: yàn guò yě, zhèng shāng xīn, què shì jiù shí xiāng shí
lines.lit: Geese pass by — just as I am grieving — yet they are old acquaintances.
lines.en: Wild geese fly over just when my heart is breaking — old friends of mine, once.

lines.zh: 满地黄花堆积，憔悴损，如今有谁堪摘？
lines.rhythm: 满地/黄花/堆积，憔悴/损，如今/有谁/堪摘
lines.py: mǎn dì huáng huā duī jī, qiáo cuì sǔn, rú jīn yǒu shuí kān zhāi
lines.lit: The ground is heaped with yellow flowers, withered and spoiled — now who would care to pick them?
lines.en: Yellow chrysanthemums lie heaped on the ground, faded and ruined — who would pick them now?

lines.zh: 守着窗儿，独自怎生得黑！
lines.rhythm: 守着/窗儿，独自/怎生/得黑
lines.py: shǒu zhe chuāng er, dú zì zěn shēng dé hēi
lines.lit: Keeping watch by the window, alone, how can I get through till dark!
lines.en: I sit by the window — alone, how will I ever last until dark?

lines.zh: 梧桐更兼细雨，到黄昏、点点滴滴。
lines.rhythm: 梧桐/更兼/细雨，到黄昏/点点/滴滴
lines.py: wú tóng gèng jiān xì yǔ, dào huáng hūn, diǎn diǎn dī dī
lines.lit: Wutong trees, and fine rain besides; till dusk, dot by dot, drop by drop.
lines.en: And now fine rain on the wutong leaves, into the dusk, drop after drop after drop.

lines.zh: 这次第，怎一个愁字了得！
lines.rhythm: 这/次第，怎/一个/愁字/了得
lines.py: zhè cì dì, zěn yī gè chóu zì liǎo dé
lines.lit: This situation — how can one word, “sorrow”, finish it!
lines.en: All of this — how could one word, “sorrow”, ever hold it?

words.note: 现代汉语仍常用，如“街上很冷清”。
古代用语，“戚”有忧伤的意思，如“休戚与共”。
今天仍是常用成语，形容早春或深秋的天气。
古代口语，现代汉语说“休养”“调养”。
现代汉语多作量词，如“一盏灯”。
现代汉语“抵挡”；“敌”今天多指敌人。
现代汉语说“老相识”“老朋友”。
现代汉语多形容人瘦弱、脸色不好。

words.en: to be worth; to be able to bear

words.note: 宋代口语，现代汉语说“怎么”“怎样”。
宋代口语，古义，和今天的“次序”不同。

words.en: to cover; to finish (here: to sum up)
words.note: 现代汉语“了得”多表示“不得了”“厉害”，如“这还了得”。

imagery.name: 雁
imagery.zh: 大雁南飞是秋天的景象，传说雁能传书，可如今再也没有可以寄信的亲人了。
imagery.en: Wild geese flying south mean autumn; they were said to carry letters — but now there is no one left to write to.

imagery.name: 菊
imagery.zh: 满地凋谢的菊花，就像词人自己憔悴、无人关心。
imagery.en: Faded chrysanthemums covering the ground are like the poet herself — worn out, with no one to care.

imagery.name: 梧桐
imagery.zh: 雨打梧桐，一点一滴，声音敲在孤独的人心上。
imagery.en: Rain dripping on wutong leaves, drop by drop, sounds right on a lonely heart.

imagery.name: 雨
imagery.zh: 黄昏的细雨下个不停，让愁绪更加绵长。
imagery.en: The fine rain at dusk keeps falling, drawing the sorrow out longer.

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 三杯两盏淡酒挡不住寒风，也解不了愁。
imagery.en: A few cups of thin wine can’t keep out the cold wind — or the sorrow.
